lines.text: Ah, now no more will I control thy griefs.
lines.plainText: Ah now no more will I control thy griefs

lines.text: Rent off thy silver hair, thy other hand
lines.plainText: Rent off thy silver hair thy other hand

lines.text: Gnawing with thy teeth; and be this dismal sight
lines.plainText: Gnawing with thy teeth and be this dismal sight

lines.text: The closing up of our most wretched eyes.
lines.plainText: The closing up of our most wretched eyes

lines.text: Now is a time to storm; why art thou still?
lines.plainText: Now is a time to storm why art thou still

lines.text: Ha, ha, ha!
lines.plainText: Ha ha ha

lines.text: Why dost thou laugh? It fits not with this hour.
lines.plainText: Why dost thou laugh It fits not with this hour

lines.text: Why, I have not another tear to shed.
lines.plainText: Why I have not another tear to shed

lines.text: Besides, this sorrow is an enemy,
lines.plainText: Besides this sorrow is an enemy

lines.text: And would usurp upon my watery eyes,
lines.plainText: And would usurp upon my watery eyes

lines.text: And make them blind with tributary tears.
lines.plainText: And make them blind with tributary tears

lines.text: Then which way shall I find Revenge's cave?
lines.plainText: Then which way shall I find Revenge's cave

lines.text: For these two heads do seem to speak to me,
lines.plainText: For these two heads do seem to speak to me

lines.text: And threat me I shall never come to bliss
lines.plainText: And threat me I shall never come to bliss

lines.text: Till all these mischiefs be returned again
lines.plainText: Till all these mischiefs be returned again

lines.text: Even in their throats that have committed them.
lines.plainText: Even in their throats that have committed them

lines.text: Come, let me see what task I have to do.
lines.plainText: Come let me see what task I have to do

lines.text: You heavy people, circle me about,
lines.plainText: You heavy people circle me about

lines.text: That I may turn me to each one of you,
lines.plainText: That I may turn me to each one of you

lines.text: And swear unto my soul to right your wrongs.
lines.plainText: And swear unto my soul to right your wrongs

lines.text: The vow is made. Come, brother, take a head;
lines.plainText: The vow is made Come brother take a head

lines.text: And in this hand the other will I bear.
lines.plainText: And in this hand the other will I bear

lines.text: And, Lavinia, thou shalt be employed in these arms.
lines.plainText: And Lavinia thou shalt be employed in these arms

lines.text: Bear thou my hand, sweet wench, between thy teeth.
lines.plainText: Bear thou my hand sweet wench between thy teeth

lines.text: As for thee, boy, go, get thee from my sight;
lines.plainText: As for thee boy go get thee from my sight

lines.text: Thou art an exile, and thou must not stay.
lines.plainText: Thou art an exile and thou must not stay

lines.text: Hie to the Goths, and raise an army there.
lines.plainText: Hie to the Goths and raise an army there

lines.text: And if you love me, as I think you do,
lines.plainText: And if you love me as I think you do

lines.text: Let's kiss and part, for we have much to do.
lines.plainText: Let's kiss and part for we have much to do

lines.text: Farewell, Andronicus, my noble father,
lines.plainText: Farewell Andronicus my noble father

lines.text: The woefull'st man that ever lived in Rome.
lines.plainText: The woefull'st man that ever lived in Rome

lines.text: Farewell, proud Rome, till Lucius come again;
lines.plainText: Farewell proud Rome till Lucius come again

lines.text: He loves his pledges dearer than his life.
lines.plainText: He loves his pledges dearer than his life

lines.text: Farewell, Lavinia, my noble sister;
lines.plainText: Farewell Lavinia my noble sister

lines.text: O, would thou wert as thou tofore hast been!
lines.plainText: O would thou wert as thou tofore hast been

lines.text: But now nor Lucius nor Lavinia lives
lines.plainText: But now nor Lucius nor Lavinia lives

lines.text: But in oblivion and hateful griefs.
lines.plainText: But in oblivion and hateful griefs

lines.text: If Lucius live, he will requite your wrongs,
lines.plainText: If Lucius live he will requite your wrongs

lines.text: And make proud Saturnine and his empress
lines.plainText: And make proud Saturnine and his empress

lines.text: Beg at the gates, like Tarquin and his queen.
lines.plainText: Beg at the gates like Tarquin and his queen

lines.text: Now will I to the Goths, and raise a power
lines.plainText: Now will I to the Goths and raise a power

lines.text: To be revenged on Rome and Saturnine.
lines.plainText: To be revenged on Rome and Saturnine
